commands: echo '=== LARGE ML REPORT REFERENCES ==='; for n in climate_v6_dagger_overnight.json climate_v6_stage11_distributed.json climate_v6_closed_loop_seed91273.json climate_v6_closed_loop_seed91273_vpd.json; do echo ---$n; git grep -n -F $n -- ':!reports/ml/' || true; done

echo '=== ALL REPORT ML BASENAMES WITH REFS OUTSIDE REPORTS ==='; for f in reports/ml/*; do n=$(basename $f); c=$(git grep -l -F $n -- ':!reports/ml/' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo $c $n; done | sort -n

echo '=== DOC BASENAMES WITH REFS OUTSIDE SELF ==='; for f in docs/*.md; do n=$(basename $f); c=$(git grep -l -F $n -- '*.md' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^'$f'$' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo $c $n; done | sort -n

echo '=== CURRENT BRANCH NAME TOKENS ==='; git grep -n -F 'mvp/environment-controller' || true; echo '=== CURRENT PROFILE REFERENCES ==='; git grep -n -F 'stage27c-crowpanel' || true; echo '=== FINAL STATUS ==='; git status --short
